skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the importance of software engineering on computers, concepts of software, classification of software, quality assessment of software, and principles of software engineering.
Understand and apply the process of specifying software requirements, including analysis and documentation.
Understand the role and strategies of software design, including various design methods and tools.
Analyze and design software using functional analysis techniques such as BFD, CD, and DFD diagrams.
Apply object-oriented analysis and design techniques using UML diagrams.
Understand and apply real-time system design principles and methods.
Understand and apply software testing methodologies, including white-box and black-box testing.
Understand and apply software maintenance processes and activities.
Manage software development projects, including quality management, configuration management, and risk management.
Develop effective communication skills, including writing reports and giving presentations.
Work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
